(2) KNI files This file is a pattern file format for the Raynen system, automatically generated after saving, and can be opened by double-clicking the file.

(3) 001 files This file is an on-board file for the enhanced model and is compiled by the Raynen system.After the pattern compilation, it is convenient for the user to understand and be controlled by the program to call the pattern split diagram, needle action diagram, loop information, yarn nozzle information and so on. (4) KNS files This file is a pattern file format of the in-form design software of the Reoncan upper-making plate, which requires the use of the upper-facing dongle to open and is used for knitted upper platemaking.Automatically generated after saving, you can open the pattern by double-clicking the file. (5) RNS file This file is the on-board file of the upper-facing machine and is compiled and generated by the in-flight process all-in-one software. And the cross- mechanical control system is required to support RNS files.After the pattern compilation, it is convenient for the user to understand and be controlled by the program to call the pattern split diagram, needle action diagram, loop information, yarn nozzle information and so on.

(6) CNT, PAT, PRM, SET, YAR file Files automatically generated after compilation of normal models: CNT: compiled after the pattern of action files, cross-machine will be based on CNT file to complete knitting and other actions, on-board need to import; PAT: compiled can be called by the program of the pattern split diagram, on- board need to import; PRM: pattern loop information (i.e. saving settings), import when on board; SET: Fancy unfold file; YAR: Record the yarn nozzle information, such as the corresponding color of the yarn nozzle, the yarn nozzle parking point, etc. 1.4.3 Process single forming Users can use the molding function in the software, only need to enter the process single parameters can automatically generate the required process, and automatically add the basic function line, automatic disassembly, marking, needle flat and so on.

The compiler has powerful automatic processing functions, such as automatic yarn, kick yarn, punching, floating wire processing, etc. Once compiled, you can view the results through PAT editor and decompile, among other things.
